title: ZecCheckout<small>Shielded Zcash checkout you host yourself</small>
caption: Accept private Zcash payments. Your server never holds a spending key.

term: $ zeccheckout serve INFO starting ZecCheckout (viewing key only) network="testnet" lightwalletd=https://testnet.zec.rocks:443 min_conf=6 INFO listening on http://127.0.0.1:8080 # configured with a Unified Full Viewing Key (uviewtest1…) only # no seed, no spending key: a breach cannot move funds
caption: The server is configured with a Unified Full Viewing Key only. If it is compromised, no funds can move.
A demo coffee shop. Buying creates an invoice server-to-server through the merchant API.
Each invoice gets a fresh diversified shielded address (Orchard + Sapling, never transparent), shown as a ZIP-321 QR code.

term: $ curl -X POST https://faucet.testnet.valargroup.dev/api/claim \ -d '{"address":"utest1…(invoice address)"}' {"id":"6eddc5a5…","status":"queued","amount":"0.125"} $ curl https://faucet.testnet.valargroup.dev/api/claim/6eddc5a5… {"status":"sent","txid":"858db20bfaa2948fc0d170769bf4d801 fc3803ba4653530258c16ac57c6b6580","broadcastOk":3} # a real zecd wallet on the public Zcash testnet; no memo attached
caption: A testnet faucet plays the customer: a real wallet sends 0.125 TAZ to the invoice address. No memo is needed; the address identifies the invoice.
Seen in the mempool within 3 seconds: transactions are trial-decrypted locally with the viewing key.
Mined. The payment is found by trial-decrypting the new compact block (Ironwood pool, same viewing key).
Matched by diversifier index: no memo fetch, no GetTransaction call. Paid after 6 confirmations (demo setting; default is 3).
The shop fulfils the order only on the HMAC-signed webhook, never on what the browser says.

term: demo-shop INFO signature verified; payment confirmed; order fulfilled order="ord_359ae3d03222ed63" webhooks (HMAC-SHA256, ZecCheckout-Signature: t=…,v1=…) seq 1 invoice.detected status=detected received_zat=12500000 seq 2 invoice.paid status=paid confirmed_zat=12500000 # no address, txid or memo in the payload
caption: Signed webhooks arrive in order (detected, then paid) and carry no addresses or txids.

title: No CDNs · no trackers · strict CSP<small>no request logs · viewing key only · self-host lightwalletd or use Tor</small>
